payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition and context for the problem of session segmentation in conversation systems, highlighting its importance and the proposed solutions.

claims.text: The problem of session segmentation involves retaining relevant context utterances while eliminating irrelevant ones in conversation systems.
Traditional document segmentation methods are not suitable for conversation session segmentation due to the unique characteristics of dialogue.
An embedding-enhanced TextTiling approach is proposed to improve session segmentation by capturing the semantics of noisy conversation utterances.
The proposed session segmentation method outperforms traditional fixed-context approaches in dialogue systems.
